# `figures/`

The D11 corpus. `gas-spbg-reactivation` carries figures on **two different tiers**, which is
the case the grouping exists for: a projection that returned them as one flat list would
invite a renderer to put a feasibility NPV and a top-line revenue potential side by side as
though they were comparable. `air-marunda-perpipaan` carries none, which is the correct
default — a dashboard with no numbers proves less than one with numbers, and is honest.
